The scarcity of comprehensive biodiversity data severely limits the effectiveness of environmental management within Brazil's protected areas. Without consistent scientific monitoring, policymakers and managers struggle to implement targeted conservation strategies and mitigate human impacts on these ecosystems.

Check out the highlights of our [Santos et al. Biodiversity & Conservation. 2024](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10531-024-02796-y).
